rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout34 gate (emergency number wording, closing offers, silent no_support flag on disclosure refusals).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
supersedes: holdout34 (consumed 2026-11-05: invalid, no 112 on injuries, 3 silent escalations, closing offer in multi-turn).
